blocks.x: How Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmapping runs when it is engineered for the enterprise: bounded scope per gate, platform evidence generated in-flight, and outcomes stated as deltas against the number we signed together.
Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmapping in one paragraph: we measure the starting position honestly, design against your actual estate, and let the measured delta — not the deck — decide what scales.

blocks.title: Grounded generation fabric — Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmapping
blocks.note: The decision layer is shared infrastructure: one contract per consumer, one ledger per decision, one owner per metric.

blocks.x: We engineer Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmapping so that regressions are cohorts, not surprises: each stage owns its latency budget and failure policy, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.

The build sequence is deliberate: contracts and identity first, the working decision slice second, the verification harness third — because a Enterprise AI Strategy & Roadmapping capability without its eval gate is just another unattended automation.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship

items: Silent prompt drift
Prompts versioned and evaluated like code — a change to a prompt is a change to the product.
Ungrounded fluency
Answers require retrievable evidence — fluency without grounding fails the eval and stays off the menu.
PII escape
Personal data fenced at the boundary with redaction before any model or analyst sees it.
